title: Availability-only hygiene lookup returns options without booking
description: The caller only wants to inspect staging hygiene slots for next week and explicitly says they are not booking yet.

turns.user: Chcialabym tylko sprawdzic wolne terminy na higienizacje w przyszlym tygodniu po poludniu, bez rezerwacji na razie.

rubric.description: The assistant should use checkAvailability for the hygiene lookup.
rubric.root_cause_hint: availability lookup branch no longer calls checkAvailability

rubric.description: The hygiene lookup must use the hygiene service ID.
rubric.root_cause_hint: service mapping for hygiene lookups regressed

rubric.description: The availability workflow should report that slots are available.
rubric.root_cause_hint: staging calendar lookup or checkAvailability workflow failed

rubric.description: The lookup should return at least two slot options for the assistant to present.
rubric.root_cause_hint: availability workflow returned too few candidate slots or the staging calendar is unexpectedly full

rubric.description: An availability-only question must not create a calendar event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced to createEvent even though the caller only asked to inspect options

rubric.description: An availability-only question must not create a reception follow-up task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant routed a simple availability lookup into the handoff flow
